OP_XBG_COPY_IMAGE_STRIDE	61	SetCopyImageStride (bytes per layer / depth slice)	no: we record it as OP_COPY_STRIDE with p_copy_stride.image = 1 (P5); the engine's own case for this op is dead code under our vocabulary
